about: Pasted and AI-written \( \) and \[ \] math as the $ and $$ notes render (docs/dev/latex_editing.md): gamma/paste_math.py and frontend/src/editor/pasteMath.js. dollar: what dollar_math / dollarMath make of in, keep being the text read before (its pairs stay as written), code and escaped brackets left alone; converting out again changes nothing. paste: text put in at the caret of at ('|' marks it, and is not part of the note), which stays as written when it lands in a code fence, inline code or math. Read by backend/tests/test_paste_math.py and frontend/tests/pasteMath.test.mjs.
